report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors. The only deployment record is a baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, and logs show all /v1/orders requests returning 200 with successful postgres, inventory and payment calls. Metrics show zero 502s on /v1/orders. No current evidence establishes a bounded root cause, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Error-bearing telemetry (non-2xx responses, error logs, or failure metrics) for checkout/order requests to substantiate any candidate cause
Deployment records showing a version change or rollout correlated with the incident window
Downstream dependency latency/error metrics for inventory and payment to test downstream-latency
Resource utilization metrics (memory, connection pool) for order service to test memory-leak or db-pool-exhaustion
